reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1001 for the 3003-receiver graph. The lower bound 1001 is an independent set (check passed). The upper bound is a linear code over F_5 with c = 1 (code_fits, factorization and decoding all passed), so the bracket is [1001, 1001]. Only one code was tried. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha also found 1001 but did not prove it, and it took 123 s against a 120 s limit. CP-SAT cover and the fractional cover gave no useful upper bound (null and 3003.0). F2 minrank SAT reached only 1000 and proved nothing. The earlier kushagra_agent also closed [1001, 1001] over F_5, in 4.4 s versus 106.4 s wall here (89.5 s compute, 16.9 s LLM). So accuracy is equal and this run is slower. Nothing suspicious. own_rank was not requested since N = 3003 exceeds 2500.
